ios.desc:
Track Every Subscription in One Smart App

Submind helps you manage all your recurring payments with powerful features and beautiful design.

Popular Services Supported: Track Netflix, Spotify, Adobe Creative Cloud, Disney+, Apple iCloud, and hundreds more with automatic recognition.

Key Features:

- Calendar View - See monthly, yearly, and custom renewal schedules at a glance
- Beautiful Detail View - Easy editing with flexible frequencies (daily, weekly, monthly, every 2 weeks, every 6 years, etc.)
- Upcoming Section - Know exactly what's next to pay
- Home Screen Summary - Quick overview of this year and this month's spending
- Smart Reminders - Get notified 1 day, 2 days, 1 week, or more before renewals at your chosen time
- Detailed Statistics - View total costs by year, all time, and average per month
- Smart Analytics - See highest/lowest paying subs, average per subscription, and category breakdowns
- Custom Organization - Create tags, assign payment methods (credit, PayPal), and add notes
- Historical Tracking - Enter past start dates to include complete statistics
- Home Screen Widgets - Beautiful widgets showing next renewals and multiple subscriptions
- Categorize subscriptions and see which categories cost you the most. Create custom tags for personalized tracking.
- Dark mode support
- Support liquid glass design

For more information, visit https://indiegoodies.com/submind
Terms of use https://indiegoodies.com/authenticator/submind
Privacy policy https://indiegoodies.com/authenticator/submind

show_hn.title: Show HN: Submind – Free Subscription Tracker

quotes.text:
Hey folks

After years of manually tracking Netflix, Spotify, and random SaaS renewals in Excel sheets, I finally decided to build something that actually makes sense — Submind.

We’ve spent the past few months designing and polishing it with a focus on ease of use and powerful features that make managing recurring payments simple (and kinda satisfying).

It’s completely free for now. More advanced features are planned and early users will be grandfathered — meaning you’ll keep full access even after we introduce paid plans later on.

What Submind does
Supports hundreds of services — Netflix, Spotify, Adobe, Disney+, Apple iCloud, and more

Calendar View — see all your upcoming renewals at a glance

Smart Reminders — get notified before payments

Detailed Analytics — total cost, categories, and monthly averages

Widgets & Filters — added recently based on user feedback

Dark Mode + Liquid Glass design for that clean iOS 26 look

We’re improving it every week and would love your feedback!

What features would you love to see next?

Family/shared subscriptions

Currency conversion

Auto import from bank or email

AI insights like “you never use this — cancel?”

Something else entirely?

Download it here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/subscription-tracker-submind/id6752399847

No sign-up, no ads — just clean subscription tracking.

Hope you find it useful, and I’d love to hear what you think!
